characters.name: Smeden
characters.description: A burly blacksmith with a muscular build, wearing a leather apron. He has short, dark hair and a soot-blackened face. The setting is a lively forest, where he is exchanging coal with other forest dwellers.

characters.name: Træskemanden
characters.description: A lean carpenter dressed in a simple tunic and trousers, with sawdust clinging to his clothes. He sports a beard and carries traditional wooden clogs in his hands. He is part of a vibrant forest scene where trades occur.

characters.name: Skomageren
characters.description: A small, agile cobbler wearing a vest and a cap. His hands are worn from years of work making shoes. He carries an array of shoemaking tools, contributing to the exchange of goods in the forest.

characters.name: Bjørnen
characters.description: A large bear with a comically short tail, standing on the ice with a surprised and confused expression. His fur is thick and brown, and the setting is a frozen lake where he has been tricked by a fox.

characters.name: Ræven
characters.description: A sly, cunning fox with a reddish-orange coat and a bushy tail. He exudes mischief as he raids a butter stash under a thick spruce bush, often depicted sneaking away with a satisfied look. His cleverness is evident as he successfully deceives the bear.
